# uzc_ip_address (Resource)

Acquires a UzCloud public IP address for a VPC or a network. A VPC needs at least one tier (a `uzc_network` with type "Vpc") before it can take an address. There is no update endpoint for IP addresses, so changing any attribute recreates the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Exactly one of `vpc` or `network` must be set. A VPC needs at least one tier
# before it can take an address. project, region and cloud_provider fall back
# to the provider block; plan defaults to the region's IP address plan.
resource "uzc_ip_address" "example" {
  network = uzc_network.example.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle slug. Falls back to the provider's `billing_cycle` default when unset.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider slug. Falls back to the provider's `cloud_provider` default when unset. Changing this forces recreation.
- `network` (String) Network slug to attach the IP to. Mutually exclusive with `vpc`.
- `plan` (String) IP address plan slug (see the uzc_plans data source with service "IP Address"). Optional: UzCloud applies the region's IP address plan when unset.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset. Changing this forces recreation.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset. Changing this forces recreation.
- `vm_guest_id` (String) Unique ID of the virtual machine guest this IP is allocated for, if any.
- `vpc` (String) VPC slug to attach the IP to. Mutually exclusive with `network`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `ipaddress` (String)
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used for import.
- `strategy` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `virtual_machine_id` (String)
- `virtual_machine_name` (String)
